# SpellStall

SpellStall is an AI prompt finding service for image and video creators.

Users choose a model and a prompt category, browse short previews and sample images, then redeem a full prompt with a card code.

Primary prompt tools:
- GPT-image
- Nano Banana
- Seedance

Core use cases:
- AI image prompts
- AI video prompts
- Product and marketing visuals
- Infographics
- Portraits and character design
- Posters, social media images, and cinematic prompts
